verdict.rationale: The questionnaire evidence covers only the outbound direction: sending security questionnaires to vendors and uploading questionnaire templates for vendor and AI-system due diligence. Nothing in the pack shows importing inbound customer questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets) or exporting answers back in the customer's original format. This axis fits a compliance platform, so the lack of evidence makes the verdict none rather than na.
